name: Latin

provides.names: Latin name (Terminologia Anatomica style) beside the English name, built from lang/latin/data: full names, 1,000+ structures with gender, 60 direction words, sides in Latin (sinister, dextra), Roman numerals for ribs and vertebrae
provides.interface: not translated: buttons and headings stay English
provides.search: not yet: search takes English names only

requires: 3D Anatomy Model page with lang/loader.js, and the lang/latin folder (compose.js and data/)
